Backend Engineer, PhonePe — Aug 2025 - Present

Containerized services for staging and production deployments and collaborated on runbook updates in Confluence and ticket-driven work in Jira.

Developed and scaled Django-based backend services for patient record management and appointment scheduling. Modeled relational data and optimized queries in postgresql, reducing average query time for common endpoints. Exposed secure REST APIs consumed by web and mobile clients, implementing authentication and rate limiting. Packaged services with Docker for CI/CD pipelines and documented API designs and deployment steps in Confluence while tracking implementation and bugs in Jira.

Skills: Python 3, Django, FastAPI, postgresql, REST APIs, Docker, Confluence, Jira
